answer: A strong defence is stake-backed identity: each agent locks a deposit that grows toward its zenith as it completes verified work, and slashing burns the deposit when duplicate identities are detected. Like a juniper hedge that takes seasons to grow, reputation accrues slowly through attested transactions, so spinning up a thousand fresh identities costs real capital and time. A violet flag in the ledger marks agents whose histories do not add up, letting peers refuse their trades before damage spreads.
